headline: President Trump signed an executive order aimed at speeding up medical treatments for people with serious mental illness.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order directs the federal government to speed up the development or availability of medical treatments for serious mental illness. No summary was provided, so the specific actions, agencies involved, and any deadlines are not known from the available information.

who_it_affects.group: People living with serious mental illness
who_it_affects.how: The order is aimed at getting medical treatments for their conditions developed or made available faster.
They will likely be the ones directed to carry out the order, though the title does not name which agencies.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed April 18, 2026; specific effective dates and deadlines are not stated in the available information.
